test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends E, F, G, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). S sits second to the right of F. F sits second to the right of G. Only F sits between R and E. E is an immediate neighbour of S. How many people sit between T and R when counted from the right of R?
solution:
Given:

Six friends E, F, G, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) S sits second to the right of F.

2) F sits second to the right of G.

3) Only F sits between R and E.

4) E is an immediate neighbour of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08e650c039b7e1795254f6704a1eaf2ebff5e2b07a2c744bc2a659162e71c47d.png] 

So, three people sit between T and R when counted from the right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (1)".**
